data.name: Sherwin
data.gender_notes: Sherwin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sherwin is derived from the Old English words 'scier' meaning 'sharp' and 'wynn' meaning 'friend'. It can also be interpreted as 'sharp warrior'. The name was popular during the Middle Ages and was borne by several saints. The name Sherwin carries the meaning “Friend, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sherwin usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength, loyalty, and friendship.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sherwin total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, the name Sherwin can be seen as a reminder of the importance of being a good friend to God and to others. The 'sharp' aspect of the name can symbolize the clear and discerning mind that God desires us to possess, while the 'friend' aspect can represent the deep and enduring bond we are called to have with Him. The name's association with warriors also highlights the spiritual battle we face in our daily lives, and the importance of being strong and steadfast in our faith.
